assets.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single transparent PNG building sprite for a realistic overhead American Civil War strategy game. Illustrative wartime reconstruction of the Stone House at First Manassas, July 1861, informed by the Library of Congress 1862 photograph shown by the National Park Service. A compact substantial rectangular TWO-STORY Virginia roadside tavern farmhouse of rough irregular brown-gray sandstone masonry. Three-bay long front facade with small white-trimmed multi-pane sash windows, a plain central wooden door and a short rough stone front step. Plain wooden shingle gable roof, two square stone end chimneys rising near the gables. Blank left gable mainly rough stone masonry. Small low timber lean-to at the rear partly visible. Austere weathered rural building, no grand porch or columns, no dormers. Three-quarter orthographic camera looking down 40 degrees; long front faces lower right, left gable visible. Fine physical material textures, realistic miniature diorama matching detailed soldier sprites. Subdued midday upper-left light. Entire isolated building centered with 10 percent margins, actual transparent alpha background. No surrounding ground, grass, landscape, trees, fence, people, flags, hospital symbols, text, backdrop, checkerboard or cast shadow outside building. Clean RGBA cutout.

Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single transparent PNG building sprite for a realistic overhead American Civil War strategy game. Illustrative reconstruction of Snodgrass House at Chickamauga in 1863, informed by Alfred Waud's drawing held by the Library of Congress, item 2004660147; interpretive, not a measured reconstruction. A modest elongated low one-story hewn-log farmhouse, visibly longer than a small single-room cabin. Squared weathered gray-brown horizontal logs with pale chinking, low continuous wood-shingle gable roof, rough stone foundation, two plain timber door openings and one small shuttered rectangular window along the long front. A prominent shouldered external chimney at the visible right gable, made from mud-plastered horizontal timber cribbing, narrowing to a straight pale clay upper flue; NOT a grand brick chimney. Small lower log lean-to extension at the rear right, as suggested in Waud's drawing. Rustic 1860s Georgia farm home, unpainted, no porch, no loft dormer, no masonry mansion. Three-quarter orthographic view looking down 40 degrees, long front faces lower left and right gable visible. Realistic miniature diorama, fine material texture, subdued midday upper-left lighting matching detailed soldier sprites. Whole building centered with 10 percent margins. Actual transparent alpha background. No landscape, ground plane, grass, trees, fence, wagon, people, flags, hospital symbols, text, checkerboard or cast shadow outside building. Clean RGBA cutout.
